items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Red Allen was gone and Red Saunders was there with Sonny Cohn, the great trumpeter, who would later play lead for the Basie band. I became friends with them

ctx.x: And then later on when I came back on another weekend pass, Red Allen was gone and Red Saunders was there with Sonny Cohn, the great trumpeter, who would later play lead for the Basie band. I became friends with them and met all those people. And he had a tenor man named Leon Washington.
So you were drafted in 1944 to the Army Air Corp, and I assume boot camp was quite an experience, cause we’re talking about Biloxi, Mississippi?
